question: Which of the following kings of the Gupta Empire was also a good Veena player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Samudragupta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Samudragupta **adopted the **title of Kaviraja **(**King of poets**).
 
• He was **an expert ' Veena' player**.
 
• Gupta King **Samudragupta loved **to play the **flute and love poems**.
 
• He not only penned many poems himself but also **patronized the poets**.
 
• Due to these, he **was titled Kaviraj**, or **King of Poets**.
 
• **Samundra Gupta **was also known as the **'Napoleon of India'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandragupta II**, also called **Vikramaditya**, powerful emperor (**reigned c. 380–c. 415 CE**) of **northern India**. He was the son **of Samudra Gupta **and **grandson of Chandragupta I**.
 
• Founder of **Maurya Dynasty **- **Chandragupt Maurya.**
 
• **Kumaragupta **I founded **the Nalanda University.**
